title: Unlearning Climate Misinformation in Large Language Models
authors: Michael Fore; Simranjit Singh; Chaehong Lee; Amritanshu Pandey; Antonios Anastasopoulos; Dimitrios Stamoulis
why_relevant: Examines poisoning LLMs with climate misinformation and compares unlearning, finetuning, and RAG as mitigation. Touches on misinformation defense but focuses on model unlearning rather than RAG robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: RAG is only one of several mitigations evaluated; not centrally about retrieval robustness, conflict, or calibration.
